relationships.subject: MOR
relationships.evidence_quote: Loss of MOR in somatostatin+ interneurons and TRPV1+ sensory neurons did not affect morphine-induced itch but impaired morphine-induced antinociception

key_findings: Intrathecal morphine elicits itch via MOR on spinal Vgat+ inhibitory interneurons, causing disinhibition of the GRPR+ itch circuit.
MOR in somatostatin+ interneurons and TRPV1+ sensory neurons is required for morphine antinociception but not itch; central MOR contributes to chronic itch.
